moments.title: US Open Tennis Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The final Grand Slam of the year, the US Open, begins today with qualifying rounds and mixed doubles play in New York, with the main draw starting August 30th.

angles.name: General Excitement
angles.copy: It's time for the final Grand Slam of the year! The US Open gets underway today with qualifying action. Who are you backing for glory?

angles.name: British Hopes
angles.copy: Game, set, match! The US Open starts today in New York. Can any British hopefuls make a deep run through qualifying to the main draw?

moments.title: Fulham host Chelsea in Premier League
moments.blurb: London rivals Fulham and Chelsea face off tonight in the final fixture of the Premier League's opening weekend.

angles.name: Match Day Build-up
angles.copy: Tonight's Premier League action wraps up the opening weekend with a London derby! Fulham host Chelsea. Who's taking the bragging rights?

angles.name: London Focus
angles.copy: West London showdown tonight! Fulham welcome Chelsea to Craven Cottage for a big Premier League clash. Tune in!

moments.title: Jean-Michel Jarre turns 78

angles.name: Electronic Pioneer
angles.copy: Happy 78th Birthday to the legendary Jean-Michel Jarre! His groundbreaking electronic soundscapes still captivate audiences worldwide. What's your favourite track?

angles.name: Concert Spectacles
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 78th Birthday to Jean-Michel Jarre! The master of sonic and visual spectacle. Imagine being at one of his shows!

angles.name: Nutty Boy
angles.copy: It's a very happy 65th birthday to Madness bassist, Mark Bedford! Still bringing that 'Nutty Sound' to the world. What's your go-to Madness track?
